changes: Remove unsupported T1546 persistence mapping from PHP fwrite/fputs and file-write composite.
Correct web request command execution MBC mapping from single-instance B0024 to command-and-control B0030.
Separate Classic ASP expression output from ASP.NET control-text/HTML-encode syntax; preserve output-rendering consumer alternatives.
Move reverse-shell terminology from objectives to neutral vocabulary and update exact consumers; preserve matchers and exclusions.
Move generic credentials path evidence to fs/path/credential; update both consumers and keep the vocabulary leaf at its 100-rule limit.
Move Ruby AES cipher-mode literals out of runtime-library into aes/mode; remove encryption mapping unsupported by a cipher name.
Move accept symbols, source call and accepting-server composites from socket/listen to socket/accept; preserve exact directory-selector membership and OR cardinality.
Move setsockopt symbol fallback into socket/configure and suppress it where canonical import evidence fires; preserve operation-level consumers.
Move fork/shell co-occurrence to process/create/fork and require a fork independently of shell evidence; two shell strings cannot assert a fork.

verification.native_payloads: 30 distinct gzip members inspected through decompressed ELF headers, imports, constructors and per-architecture disassembly; all retain two hostile traits.
verification.source_payloads: Request-to-execution, socket/pipe relay and descriptor-to-shell mechanisms inspected directly; both exploit modules reviewed through payload construction and network submission.
verification.rizin_limits: SPARC relocation handling and stripped Mettle metadata produce warnings; raw text-section disassembly and ELF imports/header facts supplement function analysis.
verification.final_required_check: make validate, exit 0 with no warnings

movement_review.tiers: API operations remain neutral capabilities; prose names remain vocabulary; required malicious actions remain objectives.
movement_review.nearest_alternatives: accept handles an established listener; listen starts listening. Cipher mode is algorithm evidence, not backend identity or encryption direction. ASP <%= %> output exists in Classic ASP as well as ASP.NET.
movement_review.selector_audit: Moved exact references replaced across YAML consumers; accept observations explicitly added to prior listen directory selectors, with ALL selectors converted to an equivalent required ANY group. Ruby AES atoms cannot match the JavaScript-only DNS directory consumer.
movement_review.fixtures: Positive and near-miss controls include routine PHP writes, Classic ASP output, prose, cipher names, credential paths, socket accept vs unrelated accept function, and a binary with shell strings but no fork.
